figurative_meaning_en: High demand or rising prices for goods, intense competition or bargaining
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকাল সোনার বাজার গরম হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This year's hilsa market is very hot.
The gold market has heated up these days.
note: The idiom reflects Bengali market dynamics, especially for seasonal items like fish.
